title: Opening m2 (v11 picture, 54.567 s): music treatment per conspiracy m4c (+9, word-speed ducking, high cut)
notes: Audio-only remix of v11 (8636f6b). The music PLAN is v11's: the sponsor groove from bar 1 beat 2 (track attack 1.278 s) with its bar 3 downbeat (5.312 s) on the WARNING card cut (4.300 s) and a 0.5 s tail; the news bed from bar 1 (0.117 s) under jingle A to its bar 18 downbeat (34.697 s) on the SPECIAL REPORT slam (52.433 s), 0.5 s tail, under jingle C. Same placement code as music-v11.py (5 ms raised-cosine head before the entry attack, raised-cosine tail from the last downbeat). No cue moved: the groove already plays from 0.268 s (the sponsor read starts 0.33 s) and the bed's entry is tied to jingle A / the BREAKING NEWS slam.

Treatment (conspiracy m4c, 70fecfa): each cue folded to mono, 100 Hz high-pass (2nd-order Butterworth), high shelf 6 kHz -6 dB and 11 kHz -8 dB, normalised to -18 LUFS integrated (whole cue) before placement. Under speech the music sits at -11.3 dB re the normalised cue (cue loudness -29.3 LUFS, m4c '+9'), +5 dB in the pauses between words; sidechain from the voices stem (v11 voice-final: sponsor, advisory, Liam at the desk, announcer), key 10 ms RMS, -44..-38 dBFS, 30 ms look-ahead attack, 300 ms release; no minimum-gap logic, no gap rises, no dip before the slam (v11's -14 gap rises, the -26 dip and the 17 dB guard trim are gone).

Spectral check (65536-point Welch, prominence over a 1 kHz running median): the groove carries a pure tone at 16.797 kHz (0.7 Hz wide, 9.1 dB over its neighbourhood over the whole cue, 10.5 dB in the 1.27-5.82 s span played here; no 2-12 kHz peak reaches it), the same artifact as the conspiracy cue's 16.8 kHz: notch 16.8 kHz -6 dB Q 8 as m4c. The news bed has no isolated tone above 12 kHz (its peaks sit on a 200 Hz grid across the whole spectrum and are stronger below 12 kHz, 12.1 dB at 8.6 kHz vs 9.7 dB at 14.8 kHz): no notch.

Intro levelling (music-m4.py level_intro, max 6 dB): the news bed's bars 1-3 are 5.3 / 2.9 / 1.8 dB under its body (3 s short-term median); levelled toward the body median, ramping out over the bar before bar 4. The groove has no quiet intro (bars 1-2 within 0.8 dB of its body): not levelled.

Sound: v11's dialogue-and-sound stem (voices, brown-noise bed) and stings stem (jingles A and C) unchanged, at v11's final gain; no stamp in this scene. Program: finish-m3.py (-16 LUFS, true peak <= -1.3 dBTP, alimiter latency-compensated).
